initial_validation_attempt.failure: MSVC treated implicit int-to-byte conversions in synthetic bitmap fill operations as errors.
initial_validation_attempt.resolution: Explicit uint8_t test values; all final workflows and packages rebuilt from source_commit.

visual_review.scope: Inspected synthetic CAS windows on Debian 12, Ubuntu 24.04 and Rocky 8: base and first XMP CAS raw bitmaps/lists, nCK units, 1N command rate, raw command byte, CRC status and existing timing rows are visible. The other profiles, all forty CAS bits, continuation rows and unknown codes are checked by Qt but are outside this screenshot viewport. Inspected the Ubuntu packaged memory page; native and release screenshots are byte-identical and show the new scope without automatic inventory scanning.

preserved_original_document_difference.scope: Existing local UMC implementation link preserved in the original directory; All 18 changed files match the cloud archive in full; unrelated original document differences are retained.

local_tests.note: Local host lacks C++/Qt/Linux toolchain; executable coverage supplied by cloud runs.

limits: Linux x86_64 packages; portable core tests do not establish Windows/macOS hardware support

DDR4/DDR5 base CAS lists, DDR4 XMP 2.0 stored voltage/timings, DDR5 XMP 3.0 manufacturer CAS/command-rate/timings and EXPO 1.0 basic profiles; no DDR4 XMP CAS or DIMM-per-channel decoding; no EXPO enhanced timings, EXPO 1.1, user slots, SPD writes, applying profiles or current trained timings
No physical hardware tuning, stability, Secure Boot enrollment or cross-version upgrade acceptance
Other previously documented restoration gaps and process-local transaction locking remain
